title: Global Arthur Enhancements of Cuspidal Excursion Parameters

abstractEnglish: Under the finite-level Ramanujan–Arthur decomposition stated in Theorem 1.1, we construct a global Arthur enhancement for every occurring cuspidal excursion parameter at a specified full finite level for a split connected semisimple group over a global function field. A single algebraic SL2 and a commuting Weil centralizer map recover the given parameter by diagonal specialization on the entire Weil group, including inertia. The result does not assert ellipticity, Arthur-packet classification, or a multiplicity formula.
titleEn: Global Arthur Enhancements of Cuspidal Excursion Parameters
titleZh: 尖点游走参数的全局 Arthur 增强

details.overview: 该稿件在全局函数域上的分裂连通半单群情形下，依据定理 1.1 所述的有限层级 Ramanujan–Arthur 分解，为指定完整有限层级上出现的每个尖点游走参数构造全局 Arthur 增强。作者声称单个代数 SL2 与交换 Weil 中心化子映射通过在整个 Weil 群（包括惯性群）上的对角特殊化恢复给定参数。摘要明确不声称椭圆性、Arthur 包分类或重数公式。
keyPoints: 在全局函数域分裂半单群上为尖点游走参数构造全局 Arthur 增强。
